description: This Java class defines a specialized event adapter for handling PolicyEvent objects within a persistence context, facilitating conversion to and from MongoDB BSON representations, and handling possible schema migrations for events stored in an Akka persistence journal.

classes.name: DefaultPolicyMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyMongoEventAdapter, responsible for converting PolicyEvent objects to and from MongoDB BSON format, and handling schema migrations.

methods.name: DefaultPolicyMongoEventAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with an optional Akka actor system and sets up migration mappings.

methods.name: createEventFrom
methods.description: Converts a JSON value from the database into a PolicyEvent object, applying migrations if needed.

methods.name: migrateComplex
methods.description: Applies migration functions to a JSON object if migrations are available for its ID.
